1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more plant embryos by agitating the plant embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and wherein the water is at a temperature between 4°C and 25°C__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold at a temperature below 0°C and then heat at a temperature above 50°C followed by agitation __in a manner that preserves DNA integrity__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material to a temperature above 50°C and agitation __in a manner that preserves DNA integrity__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __purifying and__ extracting the DNA __using a solid phase extraction method__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding __paramagnetic__ magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the globular to scutellar developmental stage__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from a single embryo without pooling__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __using quantitative real-time PCR or digital PCR__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __for agronomic traits selected from yield, disease resistance, and stress tolerance__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __using multiple displacement amplification or isothermal amplification__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __and wherein the selection is based on a predetermined breeding objective__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __within 30 days of genotyping__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using a robotic platform integrated with genotyping instrumentation__.
